Season attribution caveat: the URL that surfaced in the search (wtop.com/nfl/2025/02/...) carries a Feb 2025 path, which would normally belong to the previous season, so that URL does not by itself confirm the season; other search results dated 2026/02/06 (titles only) place the Stafford-Maye race in Feb 2026.

facts.claim: AP MVP ballot: voters submit five players scored on a 10-5-3-2-1 scale by placement.

facts.claim: For the 2025-season AP awards announced Feb 2026, voters selected a top 5 for ALL eight AP NFL awards (not only MVP), scored 10-5-3-2-1; panel of 50 media members (the 50-voter count is supported only for this 2025 season in the search copies); votes tabulated by Lutz and Carr; voting completed before the playoffs.
facts.url: https://www.clickondetroit.com/sports/2026/01/22/the-ap-nfl-mvp-finalists-are-allen-lawrence-maye-mccaffrey-and-stafford/ (AP finalist announcement copy; surfaced by WebSearch)
facts.verbatim_excerpt: Voters selected a top 5 for the eight AP NFL awards. First-place votes were worth 10 points. Second- through fifth-place votes were worth 5, 3, 2 and 1 points.
facts.source_type: WebSearch result text quoting the AP finalist article (secondary reproduction; not fetched)

facts.claim: 2025-season AP Coach of the Year results list five ranked coaches: Vrabel 302 points (19 first-place votes), Coen 239 (16), then Macdonald, Johnson, Shanahan; scored 10-5-3-2-1 (search copies). A search copy also described a top-3 5-3-1 scheme for Coach of the Year; that is reported and unverified, and conflicts with the 2025 results for that season.
facts.verbatim_excerpt: Vrabel prevailed in a close vote, finishing with 302 points (19 first-place votes). Coen came in second with 239 points (16), with Seahawks HC Mike Macdonald, Bears HC Ben Johnson and 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan rounding out the top five.
facts.source_type: WebSearch result text quoting AP results (secondary; not fetched)

facts.claim: 2025-season AP Offensive Player of the Year (Smith-Njigba 272 points, 14 first-place votes) and Assistant Coach of the Year (McDaniels 249 points, 17 first-place votes) were also tallied 10-5-3-2-1 with five ranked names.
